selection_timeline: The original three cities preceded the earlier added analyses; this six-cell dossier is a post hoc computational review. Original queue order is unchanged.

cells.selection_reason: first two original g*h queue cells
cells.computational_source_review_notes: Original Delhi g*h queue order 1; cell (771,626), centre (77.307140 E, 28.543108 N). GHSL positive increment g=3914 m2 and released integrated modelled depth h=4.092391 m; neither gives a realised flood observation. Map-specific common-grid joint fraction t=0.700000; fine marginal product=0.704700, archived product=0.690826. Archive sA=0.958231, pA=0.279061; common-grid sF=0.870000, pF=0.190000. GLAD pair new/stable/absent=0.0000%/100.0000%/0.0000%; paired coverage=1.000000. These are broad built-up class fractions, not roof-area accuracy. Positive GHSL increment coincides with GLAD stable built-up across this cell. Review focus: densification, within-cell roof increment, differing built-up definitions, registration and temporal detection; the data do not identify which explanation holds. Both retained source QA values are zero; this is not an independent accuracy certificate. This dossier performs key/value and formula checks only. No human imagery interpretation, independent reference label, construction truth or actual inundation verification was performed.
